name: @zboule/wasp-ui
description: The chat UI for a wasp thread: a headless session (any framework) and a React component

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --clean --external react --external react-dom && cp src/react/styles.css dist/styles.css && esbuild src/embed.tsx --bundle --format=iife --global-name=WaspChat --loader:.css=text --jsx=automatic --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=dist/wasp-chat.js
